adjudication.rationale: In `app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb`, both `update` and `destroy` fetch the record with `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then immediately call methods on `host` (`save_host(host)` which does `host.host = ...`, and `host.destroy`). If the id is unknown, `host` will be `nil`, leading to a `NoMethodError` (500) rather than a 404/not-found response. The diff shows no nil-check or `find`/`find_by!` usage to raise a handled not-found.
